title: The translated prime-scale kernel keeps both separator corners positive (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, deleting `{3,4,5,6}` leaves both Schur directions between vertices 1 and 8 positive. The forward corner lies strictly between `1/10^50` and `1/10^49`. The reverse corner lies strictly between `1/10^221` and `1/10^220`. The half-bandwidth is 3.
- The origin sits on vertex 0, so `t_8^2-t_1^2=63`. Vertex 1 meets the interior only at vertex 3, and vertex 8 meets it only at vertex 6.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one prime, one shift endpoint, one translated origin, and width 2, not the all-size bandwidth claim.
